description: This Java source file defines a test class 'AbstractInitSalesManagerCore' for initializing the database with languages, countries, zones, and currencies as part of testing setup for the SalesManager application. It contains methods for data cleanup, loading configuration data, and verifying an empty database state.

classes.name: AbstractInitSalesManagerCore
classes.description: Test class responsible for initializing database reference data such as languages, countries, zones, and currencies in integration tests.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Cleans database by removing all currencies, countries, languages, and zones, then verifies database is empty.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Runs initialization routines for languages, countries, and zones.

methods.name: initZones
methods.description: Loads zone configurations from external source and populates the database with zones and descriptions.

methods.name: initCountries
methods.description: Initializes country entries and descriptions based on locale data.

methods.name: initLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries for the system.

methods.name: initCurrencies
methods.description: Creates currency entities from predefined constants and handles invalid entries.

methods.name: cleanAll
methods.description: Deletes all currencies, countries, languages, and zones from the database.

methods.name: checkEmptyDatabase
methods.description: Verifies the database has no remaining entities for all mapped classes.

methods.name: listEntities
methods.description: Returns a list of entities of specified class from the database.
